[EN] Go to Commander {@linkcreature:528#5005#Tamur} at Kaiator Command Center and report that you have destroyed the Cyasma Spire at {@Rgn:49001$$Argonea}. [Speak with {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} to enter the Kaiator Command Center.]
[ES] Ve al comandante {@linkcreature:528#5005#Tamur} en el Centro de Mando de Kaiator e infórmale de que has destruido la aguja de Cyasma en {@Rgn:49001$$Argonea}. [Habla con {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} para entrar al Centro de Mando de Kaiator.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Adeldur at Kaiator Command Center. [Speak with {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} to enter the Kaiator Command Center.]
[ES] Habla con Adeldur en el Centro de Mando de Kaiator. [Habla con {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} para entrar al Centro de Mando de Kaiator.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's go."
[ES] "Vámonos."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Adeldur that you're off to investigate the researchers.
[ES] Dile a Adeldur que vas a investigar a los investigadores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Shroud Outpost at Granarkus and confirm the Agnurok Engine research results from Virienne.
[ES] Ve al puesto avanzado de Shroud en Granarkus y confirma los resultados de la investigación del motor Agnurok con Virienne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Near the Argon Energy Purifier
[ES] Cerca del purificador de energía argon
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You found the energy Virienne is tracking.
[ES] Has encontrado la energía que rastrea Virienne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the {@linkobject:120#energy purifier} southeast of Noyul Extractor in Granarkus, then open a teleportal for the researchers.
[ES] Ve al {@linkobject:120#purificador de energía} al sureste del extractor Noyul en Granarkus y luego abre un teleportal para los investigadores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate the zomgul gatherers around the energy purifier so the researchers are safe.
[ES] Elimina a los recolectores zomgul alrededor del purificador de energía para que los investigadores estén seguros.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Insert a teleport stone into the purifier so the researchers can come through a temporary teleportal.
[ES] Inserta una piedra de teletransporte en el purificador para que los investigadores puedan cruzar a través de un teleportal temporal.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Virienne, who came through the portal.
[ES] Habla con Virienne, que ha cruzado por el portal.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow Dadoam, who left to follow the energy conduits.
[ES] Sigue a Dadoam, quien se fue tras los conductos de energía.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the incubator before it produces argons.
[ES] Destruye la incubadora antes de que produzca argones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Origin of the Howls
[ES] Origen de los aullidos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You see Kelsaik!
[ES] ¡Ves a Kelsaik!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You hear Kelsaik's howl near the Incubator. Investigate the area.
[ES] Escuchas el aullido de Kelsaik cerca de la incubadora. Investiga la zona.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the Crossing the Streams near Kelsaik.
[ES] Destruye «Cruzando los arroyos» cerca de Kelsaik.

[ES] "Entiendo".
